name: thingport-grab
description: One-click import of MakerWorld, Thingiverse, and Printables models into your self-hosted Thingport instance.

scripts.zip: npm run build && tsx scripts/zip.ts chrome firefox edge sources
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && tsx scripts/zip.ts chrome
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && tsx scripts/zip.ts firefox sources
scripts.zip:edge: npm run build:edge && tsx scripts/zip.ts edge
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
